sentences.text: This animal represents a single-species group of armored fish known as arthrodires.
It belongs to the class Placodermi, a group of extinct jawed fishes.
The defining specimen was found in the Cleveland Shale near Cleveland, Ohio.
Whitley named the genus in 1933, using the species originally described by Newberry in 1885.
Taxonomically, it sits within the family Selenosteidae and the larger clade Aspinothoracidi.
Recent research from 2022 indicates it is closely related to Gorgonichthys.
This creature inhabited waters in present-day Europe and North America between 372.15 and 358.86 million years ago.
